load_mnist: load MNIST dataset selecting two classes and shuffle returning only specified number of samples
fit_and_score: fit SGDClassifier estimator on training data and score on both training and test sets
create_sgd_early_stopping: create SGDClassifier with early_stopping=True and validation_fraction to stop when validation score plateaus
create_sgd_training_loss: create SGDClassifier with early_stopping=False and tol to stop based on training loss convergence
create_sgd_no_stopping: create SGDClassifier with n_iter_no_change to stop when training loss does not improve for N iterations
